mapper.select: SELECT fs.station_name AS from_station, ts.station_name AS to_station, c.seat_type AS seat_type, COUNT(*) AS waiting_count, MIN(c.candidate_time) AS first_candidate_time FROM candidate c JOIN station fs ON fs.id = c.from_station_id JOIN station ts ON ts.id = c.to_station_id WHERE c.status = 'WAITING' AND c.travel_date = #{travelDate} GROUP BY fs.station_name, ts.station_name, c.seat_type ORDER BY waiting_count DESC
